# Cloudflare

> > Cloudflare provides a unified connectivity cloud platform delivering security, performance, and developer tools including Zero Trust, SASE, DDoS protection, DNS services, and edge computing.

Cloudflare offers comprehensive solutions for application security, data protection, network infrastructure, and developer platforms. The company serves enterprises, government agencies, and developers with products spanning Zero Trust security, DLP, browser isolation, DNS firewall, CDN services, and Workers edge computing platform.

## Key Topics

- Zero Trust
- SASE (Secure Access Service Edge)
- DDoS Protection
- DNS Security
- Data Loss Prevention (DLP)
- Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB)
- AI Security
- Rate Limiting
- Browser Isolation
- Shadow IT
- Developer Platform
- Network Security
- Data Breach Prevention
- Remote Work Security
- Edge Computing

## Zero Trust & SASE Solutions

- [Cloudflare DLP | Zero Trust Data Loss Prevention](https://www.cloudflare.com/zero-trust/products/dlp): Zero Trust DLP product protecting data across networks, apps, users, devices
- [Cloudflare SASE demo hub page](https://www.cloudflare.com/zero-trust/interactive-demo): Interactive SASE demos covering AI security, DLP, ZTNA, and GenAI controls
- [Experience Cloudflare Browser Isolation for yourself](https://www.cloudflare.com/sase/products/browser-isolation/experience): Browser Isolation demo experience for clientless RBI deployment
- [theNET | Current state of zero trust](https://www.cloudflare.com/the-net/zero-trust-network-security): Zero trust adoption trends and VPN challenges for distributed teams

## Security & Threat Protection

- [Data Breach Prevention | Data Protection Services](https://www.cloudflare.com/security/customer-data-breach): Data breach prevention using DNSSEC, SSL/TLS, and rate limiting protection
- [DNS Firewall | DNS Protection & Security](https://www.cloudflare.com/dns/dns-firewall): DNS Firewall for nameserver protection, DDoS mitigation, and rate limiting
- [Cloudflare Spectrum | Accelerate traffic and prevent DDoS attacks against RDP](https://www.cloudflare.com/application-services/products/cloudflare-spectrum/rdp): Spectrum product for RDP acceleration and DDoS protection
- [Tycoon 2FA Takedown](https://www.cloudflare.com/threat-intelligence/research/report/tycoon-2fa-takedown): Cloudforce One and Microsoft takedown of Tycoon 2FA PhaaS platform
- [theNET | A new threat has come to town](https://www.cloudflare.com/the-net/security-holiday): HTTP/2 Rapid Reset vulnerability and holiday ecommerce security threats

## Developer Platform & Observability

- [Cloudflare Observability](https://www.cloudflare.com/developer-platform/products/workers-observability): Workers Observability for telemetry, monitoring, and performance tracking
- [Developer Platform Partnerships](https://www.cloudflare.com/partners/developer-platform): Partner program for developer platform infrastructure and integrations

## Security Insights & Research

- [theNET | The growing cost of shadow IT](https://www.cloudflare.com/the-net/shadow-it): Strategies for minimizing unsanctioned app adoption and shadow IT risks
- [theNET | Chapter 8: Competing priorities in advancing preparedness](https://www.cloudflare.com/the-net/securing-future/competing-priorities): CISO challenges balancing security priorities amid budget constraints
- [theNET | Web3 security risks](https://www.cloudflare.com/the-net/web3-security): Web3 security challenges in blockchain and decentralized technologies
- [theNET | Modernizing applications for strategic growth](https://www.cloudflare.com/the-net/modernize-applications): Application modernization strategy for CISOs using rehost/replatform/refactor
- [theNET | State government CIO priorities in 2025: Cybersecurity, AI](https://www.cloudflare.com/the-net/government/cyber-security-priorities): NASCIO report on state government CIO cybersecurity and AI priorities
